notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four other Shrines.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Life's Web triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Honden of Life's Web's ability.
Resolve the copy of Honden of Life's Web's ability, creating at least five 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Spirit tokens, adding {3}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
